title: Probabilistic launch signal simulator and KPI heatmap
content:
Purpose
---
Quick working doc for a probabilistic approach to launch readiness. We combine a small scenario simulator (paper-level, not code) + a KPI heatmap to produce an evidence-backed go/no-go recommendation and an ordered list of mitigations that are scoped to product ops and infra owners.

Why this is different
---
- Instead of binary checklists, we assign likelihoods and impact buckets and then calculate an expected risk score per dimension.
- This helps prioritize mitigations that buy the most expected reduction in customer-impact.
- Designed to be fast and replayable for 24–72h pre-launch rehearsals.

Summary (TL;DR)
---
- Launch window: March 10–12 internal beta (staged).
- Primary KPI set: P50 latency, requests/sec throughput, error-rate (5xx), cost per 1k tokens, session retention (N-day).
- Current go/no-go stance (preliminary): CONDITIONAL_GO — proceed with canary + strict throttles, require 2 of 3 infra mitigations complete.

KPI heatmap (targets and current)
---
Columns: KPI | Target | Current | Delta | Priority weight
- P50 inference latency | <= 120ms | 138ms | +18ms | 0.25
- 95th percentile latency | <= 600ms | 820ms | +220ms | 0.20
- 5xx rate (hosted API) | <= 0.2% | 0.9% | +0.7% | 0.25
- Throughput (req/s sustained) | 1200 req/s | 980 req/s | -220 req/s | 0.15
- Cost per 1k tokens | <= $0.85 | $0.92 | +$0.07 | 0.05
- Session retention D7 | +5% lift | +2% | -3% | 0.10

Note: priority weight sums to 1; used in expected impact calc below.

Scenario library (short)
---
We model 4 primary scenarios with subjective probabilities (team input) + impact scores (0–10). Impact is customer-impact on primary KPI set and product edges.
1) Light traffic surprise (10% prob) — burst to 1.5x baseline for 30–60m. Impact: 4 (latency), 3 (errors) => composite 3.5
2) Regional infra degradation (15%) — region A GPUs experience 50% capacity drop; smart routing partially mitigates. Impact: 6 (throughput), 5 (latency), 7 (5xx spikes) => composite 6.0
3) Model regressions (5%) — a new model variant shows quality regressions causing re-routes and higher token usage. Impact: 7 (cost), 6 (retention) => composite 6.5
4) Control plane throttling/config bug (3%) — config propagation bug causes 10-min routing blackhole. Impact: 9 (availability), 8 (errors) => composite 8.5

Expected risk score calculation (paper)
---
For each scenario: ExpectedRisk = probability * composite_impact * relevant_kpi_weight_average. We sum across scenarios to get a total expected risk (normalized).
Example quick calc (regional infra): 0.15 * 6.0 * 0.60 (avg weight of throughput/latency/errors) = 0.54 (unitless).
Aggregate expected risk today: ~1.35 (threshold: <0.8 = green, 0.8–1.6 = amber, >1.6 = red). => amber.

Mitigation playbook (ordered by cost-effectiveness from sim)
---
Top-level constraints: any mitigation executed within 48h must be low-ops and reversible.
1) Canary + traffic shaping (owner: Marco Alvarez, infra) — deploy 10% traffic slice for 4h, validate latency/5xx; automatic rollback at 5xx > 0.5%. (Effort: low, impact est: -0.35 total expected risk)
2) Add fallback routing policy to Dedicated pool B (owner: SRE oncall) — pre-config, tested on staging; allow 2x burst routing for 30m windows. (Effort: medium, impact est: -0.28)
3) Short-term scale buffer (owner: infra provisioning) — temporary reserved capacity of 8 GPUs for 72h. Requires finance signoff for burst spend. (Effort: high, impact: -0.45)
4) Model token usage audit and conservative prompt clamp (owner: Product NLP lead) — reduce max_tokens default by 10% for first 24h. (Effort: low, impact: -0.18)
5) Circuit-breaker tuning and error budget backoffs (owner: Observability) — reduce circuit tripping threshold to detect anomalies faster. (Effort: low, impact: -0.12)

Go/no-go decision matrix (condensed)
---
Rules: must have at least 2 infra mitigations (1 or 3) and green canary pass to move to broad rollout. If aggregate expected risk > 1.6 => PAUSE and invoke escalation.
Current status: Canary deployment plan (1) ready, fallback routing (2) in progress, reserved capacity (3) pending finance. Canary scheduled for Mar 9 07:00 PT.

Quick launch checklist (operational focus)
---
- [ ] Canary deployment runbook published + page link (owner: Marco)
- [ ] Canary observability dashboard created, P90 error alert wired to oncall (owner: Zoe)
- [ ] Canary rollback trigger defined (5xx > 0.5% or P95 > 1.2s)
- [ ] Traffic shaping rules configured in routing layer (owner: infra)
- [ ] Dedicated fallback pool validated in staging (owner: SRE)
- [ ] Finance approval for short-term capacity (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Incident playbook trimmed to top-5 actions for 0–30m (owner: product-ops)
- [ ] Customer comms draft for beta cohort (owner: growth)

Escalation path (heads-up timeline)
---
- 0–10m: oncall paged, primary owner attempts immediate rollback/circuit-breaker.
- 10–30m: SCOPED_OPS team assembled (infra lead + product rep + eng-sre).
- 30–90m: Exec escalation (CTO + head of product) if availability not restored or error budget consumed >50%.

Data needs and open questions (notes to self)
---
- Need a short script to run a probabilistic sweep with current telemetry (Zoe + Marco). We should produce a small spreadsheet (Monte Carlo approximate) and attach here.
- What is the finance threshold to auto-approve short-term reserved capacity? (ask @finance slack).
- Are there any vendors on-call over the weekend for cross-region GPUs? (Marco to confirm).
- Quick A/B: if we clamp max_tokens by 10% does retention delta change? Need a micro A/B with 2k users.

Post-launch monitoring plan (0–72h)
---
- Dashboards: Live KPI tile (P50, P95, 5xx, req/s, cost per 1k tokens).
- Alerts: immediate page if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m or P95 > 1.2s for 5m.
- Daily synthesis: product-ops writes a 1–page morning brief with observed deviations and actions taken.
- 72h post mortem: 72h threshold triggers formal post-launch RCA and KPI drift analysis.

Patch notes / quick changelog (tracking doc edits)
---
- 2025-02-20: initial draft (Priya)
- 2025-02-24: added scenario library and expected risk calc (Ethan)
- 2025-03-03: updated canary schedule and finance status (Marco)

Appendix: simulation priors and impact heuristics (for reproducibility)
---
- Probabilities are subjective priors from cross-functional risk huddle (02/18/2025). Recommend running sensitivity: +/- 50% on probabilities and +/-1 on impact scores.
- Composite impact = weighted average across impacted KPI weights (see heatmap weights).

Unresolved / decisions needed before canary
---
- Finance approval for capacity (deadline: 2025-03-06 EOD).
- Finalize canary cohort list (customer IDs) and sign-off from growth/legal on messaging.
- Confirm vendor regional on-call coverage.

If you want: I can convert the scenario sims into a quick sheet (columns: scenario, prob, impact, weight_avg, expected_risk) and attach here — that will make the numeric sums explicit for non-math stakeholders.
